tuneRef.title: When I Survey The Wondrous Cross

lines: Original edition Click here to play
Fight the good fight with all thy might! Christ is thy strength, and Christ thy right; Lay hold on life, and it shall be thy joy and crown eternally.
Run the straight race thro' God's good grace, lift up thine eyes, and seek his face; life with its way before us lies, Christ is the path, and Christ the prize.
Cast care aside, lean on the Guide, His boundless mercy will provide; Trust, and thy trusting soul prove Christ is its life, and Christ its love.
Faint not nor fear, His arms are near, He changeth not, and thou art dear; Only believe, and thou shalt see that Christ is all in all to thee. A-MEN.
